jobs.title: Reserve Infantry - Royal Armed Forces
jobs.summary: Serve as a volunteer reserve infantry member of the Royal Armed Forces, supporting the United Kingdom's defence, security and military readiness.
jobs.description: RAF Reserve Infantry members serve as part-time volunteer personnel, providing additional manpower and support to the Royal Armed Forces when required. Reservists participate in training exercises, maintain their military readiness and support RAF operations under the direction of the chain of command. This role offers citizens the opportunity to contribute to the United Kingdom's defence while maintaining their regular civilian activities
responsibilities: Attend scheduled RAF training sessions and military exercises
Support active RAF personnel during operations
Maintain professional conduct and discipline as a representative of the RAF
requirements: Commitment to serving the United Kingdom as a volunteer reservist
Ability to work effectively in a team and follow instructions
Not a citizen of the Empire of Wilderburg [Security Restriction]
benefits: Access to free food, potions and other supplies in the Mess Halls of the RAF

jobs.title: Policy Officer - Ministry of the Interior & Kingdom Relations
jobs.summary: Help develop and implement government policy with a focus on introducing and administering the Wood Levy and Residential Levy.
jobs.description: The Policy Officer supports the Ministry of the Interior & Kingdom Relations in developing, coordinating and implementing domestic government policy. A key responsibility of this position will be the practical implementation of the Wood Levy and Residential Levy, including the development of administrative procedures, communication with affected citizens and residents of Welfort, and coordination with relevant government departments. The successful candidate will help translate government policy into clear, workable regulations and ensure that new measures are implemented consistently and effectively.
responsibilities: Coordinate the implementation of the Wood Levy and Residential Levy
Develop policy proposals, implementation plans and administrative procedures
Coordinate with the Treasury and other relevant government ministries
Monitor the implementation and administration of government levies
Prepare policy reports, briefings and recommendations for ministers
Communicate new policies and requirements to citizens and relevant stakeholders
requirements: Ability to analyse policies and translate them into practical procedures
Interest in public administration, taxation and government affairs
Ability to work independently and coordinate with multiple ministries and directorates-general
Commitment to serving the Government and citizens of Welfort
benefits: Opportunity to shape and implement national government policy
Direct cooperation with ministers and senior government officials
Opportunities for promotion and increased responsibility
Access to government facilities and resources

jobs.title: Councilmember - Court of Audit
jobs.summary: Fulfil an important constitutional oversight function by ensuring transparency and accountability in government finances.
jobs.description: Members of the Court of Audit independently examine public expenditure, government finances and the proper use of public funds, helping safeguard financial accountability across government.
responsibilities: Review government expenditure and financial records
Conduct independent audits of public institutions
benefits: Opportunity to fulfil an important constitutional function
Independent role within Welfort's constitutional framework
